text: On the Tel Aviv demo cycle route, several fixed lane delineators have snapped off at ground level.
The cobblestones in the shared street have shifted into an uneven ridge that catches bicycle tyres.
Old lane arrows remain visible after the road layout changed and are directing drivers into the wrong lane.
A tread is missing from the municipal pedestrian steps, leaving a gap in the staircase.
A concrete separator beside the cycle lane has broken apart and is jutting into the riding space.
Windblown leaflets now blanket the paved public courtyard; please arrange a sweep.
Bags of renovation rubble have been dumped on a public verge in the Tel Aviv demo area.
A large heap of cut branches and garden trimmings was left on the promenade for removal.
A refuse truck spilled mixed rubbish at the junction, leaving a trail across the carriageway.
Rotting vegetables have been left beside the public food-sharing cupboard and need to be cleared away.
Half the LED panels on the high-mast public light have stopped working while the remaining panels still glow.
The shade has come off the promenade lamp, so its light spills upwards instead of being contained.
The service identification plate is missing from a municipal lighting column, preventing us from identifying the lamp for maintenance.
The maintenance hatch on the streetlight column is jammed open; the internal wiring remains behind its intact sealed barrier.
A thick white salt coating has formed on the seaside lamp housing and its glass needs specialist cleaning.
An alarm clock rings repeatedly in the empty neighbouring flat for hours every morning and wakes us.
A neighbour's indoor bedroom fan rattles loudly against our shared wall throughout the night.
Late-night gaming in the adjacent apartment includes repeated loud yelling into a headset.
A group practises tap dancing on the pavement beneath our windows at night, making continuous sharp tapping sounds.
Singing lessons in the flat opposite are held at amplified volume during our building's quiet evening hours.
Something is wrong near my place in Tel Aviv. Can somebody help?
How do I renew my passport and change the name printed in it?
There is a new pothole beside an overflowing rubbish bin, and both need attention.
An exposed live wire is sparking from the streetlight pole beside the footpath.
